translation_notes: Preserves increasing roots, breadth-first queue order, increasing facet order, and first-discovery edge selection; explicit edge records replace per-simplex facet bit masks.
Exposes both marked facets and parent-child addresses from the explicit edge list; Regina stores the same incidence as dualForest_ bits.
Simplex index plus local face mask and ordered finite list replace a simplex pointer plus Perm<dim+1>; selected prefix has the same face-vertex meaning.
Selected vertices are increasing and the complement decreasing; standard-dimension lookup tables and legacy low-dimensional exceptions are deliberately not copied.

Propagates the full local ordering through each gluing and keeps one reached ordering per local face; omits Regina's complementary-vertex orientation normalization and codimension-specific appearance order.
A revisit must act identically on the first subdim+1 face vertices; link-orientation and bad-link calculations are not translated.
Checks empty and disconnected forests, exact first-discovery facets, parent facets, and ignored non-tree gluings.
Checks embedding degrees, selected-first order, figure-eight classes, and detection of a reversed edge self-identification.
